lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: One installation owns track history independently of project workspaces
value.statement: All projects use one private track database, durable spool and shared layer visibility. Resolve the actual legacy layers.db through DatabaseContext; missed histories import beside post-update tracks. SQL NULL legacy colors are filled once during schema-v2 upgrade or late import while explicit colors stay unchanged. Sent flags, segments, UUID acknowledgements and atomic backup/new pending points migrate transactionally without modifying sources; source provenance prevents duplicate bootstrap copies and deleted history reimport. Project deletion retains common tracks. Recording project-switch guards remain enabled.
